content.text: according to the hand of the king
which was by the hand of his Eunuchs
if it be good with the king
was good in the eyes of the king
that one should publish it according to the language of his people
fair of form, and good of countenance
in her, and that she were called
of those that have the charge
whom he had set before her
unto him, and to make request
for them, and I will do
let them bring the royal apparel
suffer not a whit to fail
that they should destroy and kill, and cause to perish
and she wept and besought him
be able that I may see
those which did the business that belonged to the King
